outfit: a tan canvas hunting jacket with brown leather shoulder patches over a dark green henley, a camo cap worn backwards over his locs

shamz.s1_rifle: He holds a plain bolt-action hunting rifle with no logos pointed safely at the sky, resting on his shoulder, confident grin at the camera. Background: a misty Florida swamp at dawn, cypress trees, Spanish moss.
shamz.s2_scope: He crouches in tall grass looking through a rifle scope, focused, one eye closed. Background: a Florida wetland at golden hour, a deer far away in the reeds.
shamz.s3_smile: He stands relaxed with his arms folded, smiling at the camera. Background: a rustic Florida hunting lodge porch at sunset, antlers above the door, no readable signs.

scenes.b_lodge: A rustic wooden hunting lodge in the Florida backwoods at golden hour, antlers on the wall, a pickup truck, no readable signs, no logos.
scenes.b_deer: A white-tailed buck standing in misty Florida wetland grass at dawn, cypress trees, soft golden light.
scenes.b_gator: A large alligator resting on a muddy swamp bank at dusk in Florida, cypress roots, Spanish moss, still water reflections.
